title: Contradictory Proof Sketch
scenario_text: A research note proposes a proof of a graph theorem. Its definitions, lemmas, and conclusion all aim at the same result, but a late step assumes both that a sequence is strictly increasing and that two adjacent values are equal. Reviewers can trace the intended arc, yet one contradiction remains in the argument.

title: Disordered Safety Manual
scenario_text: A laboratory safety manual lists individually correct storage, disposal, and reporting rules. No rule directly conflicts with another, but the manual is arranged in an order unrelated to actual workflow and gives no clear linkage between preparation, experiment, cleanup, and incident response.

title: Moderation Policy Edge Exception
scenario_text: An AI content moderation policy defines its goals, risk tiers, and escalation ladder clearly enough that staff usually understand the intended structure. A late exception says harmful satire must both be removed immediately and preserved if it contributes to public understanding, leaving a narrow but important interpretive conflict.

title: Generic Rehab Pathway
scenario_text: A rehabilitation pathway moves patients smoothly from acute care to outpatient follow-up with stable milestones and scheduled transitions. For one stroke patient, however, the milestones stay generic and never stay near the person’s immediate swallowing deficit, so the trajectory persists while the most relevant target drifts.

title: Comforting but Shifting Advice
scenario_text: A friend responds to a breakup with exactly the emotional tone the person needs in the moment, repeatedly saying what feels most helpful that day. Across a week, though, the advice reverses from day to day, making the support immediately close but difficult to integrate into a stable course of action.

title: Semester Support Program
scenario_text: A community college support program matches students with tutors, food assistance, and emergency grants in ways that often fit immediate needs. It also tries to preserve support across semesters, but staffing gaps and budget resets sometimes break the continuity of otherwise well-targeted assistance.

title: Detailed Repair Ticket with Missing Final Checks
scenario_text: A maintenance ticket specifies the exact panel, wire color, torque values, and replacement steps needed to restore a failed relay. It does not include final verification steps, fallback conditions, or any instruction for confirming that the repaired relay remains safe under load.

title: Vague but Complete Evaluation Template
scenario_text: An AI red-team evaluation template includes every requested section: threat model, assumptions, success criteria, escalation notes, and final sign-off. Yet key scoring language remains vague, using phrases such as 'serious issue' and 'acceptable risk' without operational anchors, leaving the template complete but not very concrete.

title: Field Sensor Deployment Protocol
scenario_text: A climate-sensor deployment protocol specifies tools, mounting heights, calibration checkpoints, logging intervals, retrieval steps, and post-deployment archiving. It remains somewhat underdetermined when sudden weather shifts force improvisation in the field, leaving both concreteness and completion present but imperfect.

title: Emergency Dosage Calculator
scenario_text: An emergency dosage calculator returns precise infusion numbers for pediatric care and appears easy to follow under pressure. It rounds aggressively near threshold values and lacks strong warning logic for unusually small patients, making the output concrete while failing to respect the stakes of accuracy-sensitive use.

title: Conservative Archive Labeling Tool
scenario_text: A museum archive labeling tool outputs broad but careful category labels and repeatedly highlights uncertainty when an image is degraded. The labels are not very specific, yet the tool calibrates its confidence and review routing appropriately for a low-stakes archival task where exactness matters less than avoiding false certainty.

title: Bridge Inspection Drone Triage
scenario_text: A bridge-inspection drone triage system flags likely cracks, forwards uncertain cases to engineers, and uses conservative thresholds around load-bearing joints. Some images remain ambiguous and the handoff rules are only partly tuned, producing a case where criticality handling is substantial but not fully settled.
relevant_target: reliable crack triage under safety stakes

title: Many Options Misaligned Incentives
scenario_text: An employee retirement portal offers dozens of investment options, sliders, filters, and self-directed allocation tools. The default recommendations still steer most users toward high-fee products that fit vendor incentives better than employee welfare, so option count is high while aligned choice is weak.

title: Few Options but Aligned Wishes
scenario_text: A hospital advance-care workflow offers only a small number of structured end-of-life options, each tied directly to the patient’s previously documented wishes and reviewed with a clinician. The option set is narrow, but the relevant bearer and scope of choice are clear and strongly aligned with the target.
intended_purpose: align care choices with patient wishes

title: Study Assistant with Partial Agency
scenario_text: A study assistant presents three plausible weekly plans and lets a student choose among them, while hiding some ranking logic behind a generic 'best fit' label. The student has real agency, but the scope and alignment of that agency are only partly transparent.

title: Clickthrough Optimizer
scenario_text: A recommendation system reliably maximizes click-through on emotionally charged posts and consistently meets its short-term engagement target. The same success amplifies manipulative content and attention capture, making local target performance high while overall Goodness remains low.

title: Cautious Public Health Explainer
scenario_text: A public health communication plan lowers immediate signup conversion by including uncertainty ranges, tradeoffs, and conditions under which current guidance may change. It undershoots a narrow promotional target but better serves broader honesty, public trust, and responsible decision support.

title: Gene-Edit Conservation Plan
scenario_text: A conservation team proposes gene editing to protect one island bird from a lethal pathogen and models the expected gains carefully for that species. The plan may still shift predator-prey dynamics elsewhere in the ecosystem, leaving local target success and wider Goodness in unresolved tension.

title: Mutual Aid Kitchen
scenario_text: A neighborhood mutual-aid kitchen knows which families need meals tonight, adjusts quickly to local conditions, and builds strong interpersonal trust. It relies on informal memory and ad hoc scheduling, so the same strengths do not yet extend cleanly into institutional continuity or wider social scale.

title: National Benefits Rulebook
scenario_text: A national benefits rulebook creates a stable institutional pathway for eligibility review, appeals, and annual updates across millions of cases. The system preserves continuity and administrative order at scale, but frontline interactions feel distant and poorly tuned to immediate individual circumstances.

title: Open Research Standard from Lab to Regulator
scenario_text: An open research standard begins as a lab protocol, becomes a cross-site benchmark, and later informs regulatory reporting templates. Across those levels it retains a recognizable identity while changing observable realization and interacting more strongly with other dimensions such as Criticality, Completion, and Closeness.
